name: Jam Barrel
body:
School conjuration; Level ranger 1, sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V,S

EFFECT

Range Touch
Targets one firearm or one firearm carried by target creature
Duration Instantaneous
Saving Throw Will negates (object); Spell Resistance Yes (object)

DESCRIPTION

Your successful melee touch attack causes a jam in the targeted firearm. Clearing the jam takes one full-round action, and any ammunition in the firearm is lost.
